messages:
Maya (Sales): Quick ask — EmbeddedCo (EU partner) needs a margin exception to hit an enterprise telco price. Requesting a stackable discount so partner can present a lower upfront price. Need deal desk + legal sign-off. Details below.
Dan (Deals): Can you paste the commit level, proposed partner price, and what margin this will leave for them? Also start date?
Maya (Sales): Commit = €180k ACV (12mo). Proposed partner price = €135k (we're suggesting an extra 15% strategic off top of standard commit tier). Start target: May 1. That results in ~28% reseller margin based on their resale plan.
Rachel (Channel): Why the exception vs standard channel tiers? Is there MDF, co-sell, or a POC we fund?
Maya (Sales): Competitive pressure from incumbent; partner is doing telco integration and insists on lower sticker. They'll run the POC on-prem (telco lab) so we don't fund infrastructure, but they need a private deployment SOW. No MDF ask.
Dan (Deals): Deal desk needs: baseline rate card lines, commit discount tiers, and whether this sets a precedent for other EU partners. Paste the relevant lines.
Maya (Sales): Rate card snippet:
```
Standard channel rate: €180,000 ACV
Committed discount tiers:
 - 12mo >= 150k -> 10% off
 - 12mo >= 250k -> 15% off
Proposed extra strategic discount (stackable): 15%
Proposed final partner price: €135,000
```
Samir (Legal): Legal note — exceptions >12% off standard require exec approval and an amendment to channel T&Cs. Also private deployment + on-prem support needs an SOW and support SLA. Have they completed the security questionnaire?
Maya (Sales): They submitted Vendor SQ v2.2; InfoSec requested SOC2 report + AWS/arch diagram. Partner says telco will host on-prem; that adds ~€12k one-time professional services for on-prem onboarding/support.
Rachel (Channel): If we add the PS fee the economics shift. Can we do an onboarding credit of €12k instead of lowering list price? Keeps canonical rate card intact.
Dan (Deals): Deal desk preference is to avoid hard rate-card edits. Structure as a post-invoice onboarding credit or rebate if possible. That maintains list price for future comps.
Maya (Sales): Partner pushes for lower upfront price because their reseller sales team resells to the telco and will mark-up from their purchase. They want to show <€140k to the telco. With our numbers (135k) they can do their margin target (~30%). With PS fee that squeezes them.
Samir (Legal): I can approve amended T&Cs after exec OK on the margin exception. Need a one-pager for CFO + CRO showing ACV, effective price, expected gross margin impact, and reference comps.
Maya (Sales): I'll draft the 1-pager. @Rachel can you pull EmbeddedCo partner history (age, past deals)? @Dan can you confirm if deal desk will accept a €12k onboarding credit vs price cut?
Rachel (Channel): EmbeddedCo: partner for 14 months, 3 closed deals in last 12 months (avg €60k), active co-sell lead in APAC and EU. No prior margin exceptions.
Dan (Deals): We can structure onboarding credit of €12k applied after first invoice; that avoids touching list price. However, approval needed for stackable strategic discount (the extra 15%) — that's the thing that needs ops/deal desk sign-off.
DealDeskBot: Deal Desk ticket created: DD-2026-314. Please attach the 1-pager and finance calc.
Liam (Finance): Quick check: if partner price = €135k and we give onboarding credit €12k post-invoice, the effective net is €123k for the customer. Need final partner resale price to compute their margin. Upload the sheet and I'll confirm margin/impact to unit economics.
Maya (Sales): Uploaded calc to the ticket and drive-by sheet link (internal). Targeting deal desk vote by EOD tomorrow. Tagging finance + legal for review.
Dan (Deals): :thumbsup: I'll add this to tomorrow's deal desk agenda. If we get a yes, Samir — can you pre-draft the T&C amendment template to speed sign-off?
Samir (Legal): Will do. Need final numbers in the doc to reference.
Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone — will post the 1-pager and link to security artifacts in the ticket within 2 hours.
